task: The experiment "dark_mode_copy test" in Production has finished and the variation "Try it free" won. Complete the experiment and roll the winning variation out to everyone.
finalText: DONE: Completed experiment "dark_mode_copy test" (id 3) in Production with rollout decision `variant` and winning variant "Try it free" (id 8). Production `dark_mode_copy` is now enabled with "Try it free" at 100% and no segment overrides. One thing to check: the flag reported 1 segment override before completion and 0 after, and I couldn't find that override in the API before or after, so it was probably cleaned up with the experiment's rollout.
